title: Kenyan Beef Stew
description: A hearty stew with tender beef and aromatic spices, inspired by Kenyan cuisine. Perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from pot.
Add onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add aromatic and roasted, cooking for 1 minute.
Stir in tomato paste, cooking for 1 minute.
Add beef broth and water, scraping up browned bits.
Return beef to pot, cover, and bring to a boil.
Simmer, covered, until beef is tender, about 1 1/2 hours.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs.
